title: Checking the IMEI Number When Buying a Used Phone
excerpt: Learn why checking the IMEI number is a crucial step when purchasing a pre-owned smartphone to uncover its history.
body_html:
When purchasing a pre-owned smartphone, checking the device's International Mobile Equipment Identity (IMEI) number is highlighted as a critical step.

According to recent guidance, evaluating the IMEI number can help buyers uncover whether a specific mobile device has a questionable history or other hidden issues before finalizing a purchase.
